description: This file defines an abstract class 'SimpleMapOperation' used to perform specific operations on data fields within the 'minilang' component of Apache OFBiz. It includes methods for initialization from XML elements, message handling, and an abstract 'exec' method meant to be implemented for specific operation logic.

classes.name: SimpleMapOperation
classes.description: An abstract base class representing a single operation in a mapping process, capable of producing messages and executing an operation on input data.

methods.name: SimpleMapOperation
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the operation from an XML element and a parent process, extracting fail-message or fail-property configurations.

methods.name: getFieldName
methods.description: Returns the name of the data field associated with this operation.

methods.name: addMessage
methods.description: Adds a message to the messages list, either using a direct message, a property, or a default error message, optionally resolving i18n properties.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Abstract method to execute the operation, to be implemented by subclasses, transforming input data and populating results and messages.
